hypothesis.statement: The init-8 model-array mismatch in stage CPU v1 arose because one ControlEnv and its Python/NumPy reset-time RNG state were reused across traces; a fresh per-trace worker with the registered pre-construction environment seed 12351 should recreate the saved init-8 arrays and simulator state for both matched traces.
evidence: The first positive trace (single init8) matched model arrays, simulator state, every recorded action/reward, and the terminal outcome exactly.
The immediately following joint init8 trace failed model-array validation before any applied action; stage v1 had reused the same environment object.
The frozen launcher starts a separate evaluator subprocess for every rollout, unlike stage v1's 40-trace shared environment.
The existing environment-only reset contrast found pre-construction seeding changes reset-time body geometry; it did not uniquely identify the stage-v1 failure mechanism.
hypothesis.falsifier: In a fresh worker for each trace, with Python and NumPy seeded to 12351 before environment construction and the same init8, reset, state-restore, and wait10 protocol, either trace still fails its saved pre-action model-array or simulator-state check. Such a result falsifies this lifecycle hypothesis or leaves an unmodeled protocol difference; stop without stage interpretation.
hypothesis.interpretation_limit: This is a method-validation smoke only. Even if both init8 traces pass, it does not establish the four-timeout stage hypothesis, causal multi-task interference, deterministic replay for other inits, or a progression gate.

options_compared.option: Treat the one successful v1 trace as enough and infer timeout stages
options_compared.reason: The paired joint trace failed before action replay; there is no validated comparison.
It would repeat a known first-execution error without isolating the confirmed shared-environment lifecycle deviation.
The frozen evaluator creates an offscreen renderer, which initializes a render context; exact zero-GPU use has not been established and the selected budget is zero.

options_compared.option: Run only the paired init8 positive/timeout traces, each in a fresh CPU headless worker with RNG reset before construction and strict model/state/action parity checks
options_compared.reason: This is the smallest falsifiable test of the lifecycle/RNG hypothesis and preserves the zero-GPU, no-policy, no-new-rollout budget. Model arrays and simulator state must match before any recorded action is applied; the headless renderer difference remains an explicit limitation, not assumed harmless.

scope.protocol: benchmark init8; reset; restore saved init state; exactly 10 zero-action wait steps; seed NumPy to recorded effective seed after wait; replay saved applied actions only
scope.source_integrity: Pin and recheck summary/actions/protocol/first_input SHA-256 immediately before each worker reads a trace; require evaluator/checkpoint/source manifest identities from the existing v2 registration.

execution_bounds.outputs: Only lightweight per-trace JSON and terminal manifest/failure markers on the private GPU host; no raw actions, traces, videos, logs, data, or weights copied.

stop_conditions: runner or test hashes are not pinned, or tests do not validate the fresh-worker/no-policy/zero-action-physics contract
SSH source hashes or evaluator/checkpoint identity differ
GPU utilization is nonzero, a GPU compute process exists, an existing lock is unavailable, or any GPU use is required
either trace fails pre-action model-array or simulator-state parity
any action, reward, step-count, success, or native-stage parity check fails
timeout, output collision, malformed source record, or first execution error
conditional_followup: If both init8 traces pass in the isolated workers, do not automatically expand to the other 38 traces. First audit the result, then create a separate bounded registration for any broader stage analysis. If either fails, preserve output and stop without retry.
authorization_note: No execution is authorized by this draft until implementation, unit tests, source/code hash pins, and remote path-absence preflight are recorded. GPU budget remains zero.
